mapper.sql: r.id, r.record_no, r.operation_type, r.data_set_id, ds.data_set_name, ds.category_id, r.total_count, r.completed_count, r.failed_count, r.record_status, r.current_stage, r.result_storage_key, r.error_message, r.operator_id, r.version, CASE WHEN r.total_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(((r.completed_count + r.failed_count) * 100) / r.total_count AS INTEGER) END AS progress, r.start_time, r.finish_time, r.create_time, r.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_import_export_record r JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = r.data_set_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.operation_type = 'IMPORT' AND r.record_no = #{recordNo}
